name: monitoring
description: Vendor-neutral observability and monitoring expertise across 11 technologies: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch/Kibana), OpenTelemetry, Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Zabbix, Nagios, and PagerDuty. Covers metrics, logs, traces, SLO/alerting design, and incident response.
